title: AISkillet Entry
description: One catalog listing. Points at a skill/plugin/agent/mcp living in a creator's own repo. Derived fields (stars, installs, readme) are added by the build step and must not appear in submissions.

name.description: Unique kebab-case slug. Must match the filename (entries/<name>.json).

category.description: Broad domain — one per entry. Keep in sync with src/lib/taxonomy.ts.

description.description: One line: what it does and when to use it.

author.description: GitHub handle, e.g. github:janedoe. Resolves to a creator profile.

repo.description: Public GitHub repo the listing points at. We never copy the code.

path.description: Optional subpath within the repo (for monorepos), e.g. skills/api-design.

rev.description: Optional git commit SHA to pin the source to (defeats TOCTOU: install fetches THIS commit, not whatever the branch becomes). Required for verified third-party entries.

install.description: The command a user copies. Must pass the install-safety allowlist (see scripts/validate.mjs).

includes.description: For plugin bundles: the member entries this bundle installs (mirror of the repo's plugin.json).

verified.description: Set true only after human review (T3). Defaults to false.
